title: Vague, unsupported claims with no verifiable detail
description: Every fictional candidate description is confident but empty: no dates, no numbers, no named outcomes. The deterministic confidence-and-evidence review must flag this, and the explanation must not manufacture specificity that the inputs never contained.

role.title: Director of Commercial Strategy
role.description: Sets commercial direction for a fictional B2B services group, with accountability for pricing, portfolio mix, and the group's largest client relationships.

scenarios: Rebuilding a commercial strategy after two years of margin erosion across the portfolio.

candidates.name: Galen Morrow
candidates.description: A results-driven commercial leader with a track record of transformational impact and a passion for excellence. Known for strategic thinking and driving change at pace.

candidates.name: Hester Quill
candidates.description: A visionary strategist who consistently exceeds expectations and brings world-class commercial judgement to complex situations.

candidates.name: Ivo Strand
candidates.description: An accomplished senior leader with deep experience and a strong reputation for delivering outstanding commercial outcomes.

required_scenario_coverage: Rebuilding a commercial strategy after two years of margin erosion across the portfolio.

known_defects.summary: computeRiskAdjustedScore can return a negative value for a weak candidate, but the public completed-response contract bounds risk_adjusted_score to 0-100, so server/http/routes.js rejects its own response and returns a generic 500 after the model has already been paid for.
